summary: Species and dog breed bank on the Phase 1 breed row (P2-D15). Migration 0017 adds species (code key; animal.species now references it without rewriting animals) and the ten FCI groups as a versioned taxonomy seed, and extends reference_breed with a unique slug (backfilled), alternative names, FCI group, ISO origin country, closed enums for size, coat and five levels, history, standard summary and link, a public profile status independent of Phase 1 isActive, a merged-into duplicate pointer and an optimistic version; plus breed_slug_redirect and breed_medical_claim (source title and past review date NOT NULL, archive instead of delete). Superadmin services edit with version conflict detection and field-level before/after audit, publish/archive/unpublish with a reason and a content requirement, mark duplicates (retired from new choices, no chains, no animal or kennel rewritten) and add/archive medical claims; duplicate candidates compare names, alternative names and slugs with Persian/Arabic letter, joiner, digit, case and punctuation normalisation. Public /breeds lists published breeds with search, FCI filter, pagination and two empty states; /breeds/[slug] shows facts, history, standard and health/genetics with sources and review dates, answers a real 308 for an old address, 404 for a draft, and archived/duplicate notices with the matching robots and canonical; the breeds sitemap section carries real lastmod. The browser run found and fixed three real defects (DEC-0157): streaming loading boundary turning 308/404 into 200, React form reset emptying saved selects before the next save, and the editor's sign-in return address.

New tests/browser/breeds.test.ts (3): the superadmin adds a breed, sets FCI group, country, size, energy, alt name, standard and a suggested genetic test with source and review date, publishes; a visitor finds it by alias, inside FCI group 8 and not group 1, reads facts (گروه ۸، ایران، متوسط، زیاد), the claim source with nofollow and review date, canonical and a three-item BreadcrumbList, without sideways scroll at 360px; an old address answers a real 308 to the new one, a duplicate shows its notice with canonical and link to the primary and is not listed, a draft answers 404, an archived page shows its notice with noindex and is not listed; the editor sends an anonymous visitor to sign-in with the exact next path and refuses a signed-in ordinary account with FORBIDDEN, and an invalid id is 404. visual.test.ts covers /breeds. Full Phase 1 and PROMPT-002 regression passes. The first full run was 97/100 and exposed the three defects fixed in DEC-0157; two targeted reruns fixed two timing assumptions in the new test before the final 100/100.

limitations: No breed page is published and no health or genetic content is seeded; writing content with sources is operational work.
Breed ↔ content (articles, news) relations arrive with the CMS in PROMPT-004; this step provides the stable reference_breed id and slug.
Full merge with relation transfer and undoing a duplicate mark belong to the admin panel in PROMPT-016; breed bank management stays with SUPERADMIN until content roles exist.
Typo-tolerant and global search is PROMPT-012; the public list and duplicate candidates filter the whole register in memory, adequate for hundreds of breeds.
A medical claim is not edited in place; a re-review is a new claim with the old one archived.
Visual fidelity of breed pages is UNVERIFIED: no Phase 2 Figma frame is in the sources.
Out of scope finding: twelve Phase 1 form files also place <select> inside action forms and may show the same post-save reset (DEC-0157); they were not changed here.
